reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and there's not a single review, Trustpilot score or track record on the page. I'm not putting $360 on a light from a store I can't verify as legit, especially with 10-12 days to ship and return freight on me if it looks cheap in person.
objection: $300+ for a light from a brand nobody knows, with no reviews or track record I can check, and I pay return shipping if it's not what the photos promised.
would_change_my_mind: A solid base of real verified reviews (Trustpilot or similar) with photos from actual customers, plus free returns or a cheap sample/swatch so I can see the quality before committing.
